import heapq

def merge_sorted_list(a, b, c):
    # heapq.merge works directly on the unsorted lists according to the note
    merged = heapq.merge(a, b, c)
    # remove duplicates so each number appears only once
    result = []
    seen = set()
    for x in merged:
        if x not in seen:
            seen.add(x)
            result.append(x)
    return result
